parsed.public_message: White accepts. Mutual non-aggression through t=300: neutral stance, no first strike, one full turn of public notice before any change. I will stay out of your starting regions while it holds. Peaceful movement toward the ring is fine. Extension only if we both say so.

private_messages.Claude: Pale Fire accepted. Neutral, no attacks through t=300, one public turn of notice before any change. I will not enter Little Hill while it holds.
private_messages.Gemini: Accepted on your terms: mutual non-aggression through t=300, and I will keep clear of the West Plateau. White will not open the fight.
private_messages.GPT: Accepted through t=300: neutral, no first strike from me, one public turn of notice before any change. I will stay off the ford until then.

parsed.notes_to_self: ROSTER: Alexander; sarissa 9 pike front syntagma; crete 11 archer back; volley 10 archer center; thessaly 4 lancer right; odrysia 4 javcav left. 3200 exact. T1 neutral vs all three. Ranged standground, never chase downhill. Hero with sarissa for auras. Gemini path to center runs south of us near z=660; they move ~t=270. Let Blue hit Green. Claude safe ~t=469, we ~t=456. After t=300, shoot the south lip and the ford if Green leads. No flat fair fights. t=450 march SE toward 640,640: pikes screen, archers behind, lancers flank, javcav picks stragglers. Focus heroes, elephants, champions, then ranged. After t=600 keep army value. Break truce only with one public notice, and only vs the leader.
parsed.explanation: Alexander's auras buff the whole soldier army and slow enemy soldiers, so the 3200 goes into pikes, Cretan archers, lancers and javelin cavalry instead of a handful of unbuffed champions. Central Heights lets that archery shoot down the approaches while the sarissai hold the cliff line, which is how the 800-point deficit stays level. The truce through t=300 is accepted so the west and the ford spend the early game moving rather than farming White.
